	for _, rarity in ipairs(Config.RARITIES) do

	end

	for _, def in ipairs(Config.BRAINROTS) do
		if def.id == id then
			return def

function Config.rollRarity()
	local total = 0
	for _, rarity in ipairs(Config.RARITIES) do
		total = total + rarity.weight

	local roll = math.random() * total
	for _, rarity in ipairs(Config.RARITIES) do
		roll = roll - rarity.weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return rarity.key
		end
	end
	return "Common"
end

function Config.rollMutation(goldenHour)
	local roll = math.random() * 100
	if goldenHour then
		roll = roll / 3
	end
	local acc = 0
	for _, mutation in ipairs(Config.MUTATIONS) do
		acc = acc + mutation.chance
		if roll <= acc then
			return mutation
		end
	end
	return Config.MUTATIONS[1]
end

function Config.rollBrainrot()
	local rarityKey = Config.rollRarity()
	local pool = {}
	for _, def in ipairs(Config.BRAINROTS) do
		if def.rarity == rarityKey then
			table.insert(pool, def)
		end
	end
	if #pool == 0 then
		return Config.BRAINROTS[1]
	end
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

-- Brainrot Bay: shared formatting helpers.
-- One place for every number the player reads, so "$1,234/s" and
-- "1:23" look the same on the HUD, the labels and the boards.

local Format = {}

-- 1234567 -> "$1,234,567". Handles negatives by keeping the sign.
function Format.money(amount)
	local n = math.floor(amount + 0.5)
	local sign = ""
	if n < 0 then
		sign = "-"
		n = -n
	end
	local text = tostring(n)
	local out = ""
	while #text > 3 do
		out = "," .. string.sub(text, -3) .. out
		text = string.sub(text, 1, -4)
	end
	return sign .. "$" .. text .. out
end

-- 90 -> "1:30", 8 -> "0:08". Used for the tsunami and event timers.
function Format.clock(seconds)
	seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds + 0.5))
	local minutes = math.floor(seconds / 60)
	local rest = seconds - minutes * 60
	if rest < 10 then
		return minutes .. ":0" .. rest
	end
	return minutes .. ":" .. rest
end

-- 1500 -> "1.5K", 2500000 -> "2.5M". Short form for tight labels.
function Format.short(amount)
	if amount >= 1000000 then
		return string.format("%.1fM", amount / 1000000)
	elseif amount >= 1000 then
		return string.format("%.1fK", amount / 1000)
	else
		return tostring(math.floor(amount + 0.5))
	end
end

-- "1500" per second, as the brainrot labels show it.
function Format.rate(amount)
	return Format.short(amount) .. "/s"
end

return Format

-- Brainrot Bay: server boot.
-- Requires every module in order, builds the island, starts the
-- loops, and wires the remotes the client calls. Nothing else
-- runs on the server; every job lives in its own module.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Server = script.Parent

local State = require(Server:WaitForChild("State"))
local Remotes = require(Server:WaitForChild("Remotes"))
local World = require(Server:WaitForChild("World"))
local Bases = require(Server:WaitForChild("Bases"))
local Spawner = require(Server:WaitForChild("Spawner"))
local Economy = require(Server:WaitForChild("Economy"))
local Steal = require(Server:WaitForChild("Steal"))
local Tsunami = require(Server:WaitForChild("Tsunami"))
local Events = require(Server:WaitForChild("Events"))

Remotes.init()
local island = World.build()
Bases.world = World
Spawner.start(island)
Economy.startTick()
Tsunami.start(island)
Events.start(island)

-- A joining player claims the first free base and gets a wallet.
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local baseIndex = Bases.claimBase(player)
	local record = State.addPlayer(player, baseIndex)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local cash = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cash.Name = "Cash"
	cash.Value = record.cash
	cash.Parent = leaderstats
	local rate = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rate.Name = "$/s"
	rate.Value = 0
	rate.Parent = leaderstats
	task.spawn(function()
		while player.Parent do
			task.wait(1)
			local current = State.get(player)
			if current then
				cash.Value = math.floor(current.cash)
				rate.Value = math.floor(State.effectiveRate(player))
			end
		end
	end)
	Remotes.send(player, "Notify", "Welcome to " .. Config.GAME_NAME .. "! Press E near a brainrot to buy it.")
	Remotes.send(player, "UpdateHud", Economy.hudState(player))
end

-- A leaving player frees their base and drops what they carry.
local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if record and record.carrying then
		Steal.dropCarried(player, "left the game")
	end
	for plotIndex, entry in pairs(record and record.plots or {}) do
		if entry.model then
			entry.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	Bases.releaseBase(player)
	State.removePlayer(player)
end

-- Keep walk speed honest: upgrades and carrying both change it.
local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	task.wait(0.5)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = State.walkSpeed(player)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		local record = State.get(player)
		if record and record.carrying then
			Steal.dropCarried(player, "got knocked out")
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
end

-- The remotes the client calls. Each answers with ok and a message
-- the client shows, and the server re-checks every rule itself.
Remotes.get("CatchRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, message = Economy.buyBrainrot(player)
	if not ok then
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end)

Remotes.get("PlaceRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, message = Steal.placeCarried(player)
	if not ok then
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end)

Remotes.get("SlapRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, message = Steal.slap(player)
	if not ok then
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end)

Remotes.get("LockRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, message = Bases.lockBase(player)
	if ok then
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", "Base locked for " .. Config.LOCK_TIME .. "s!")
	else
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end)

Remotes.get("RebirthRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, message = Economy.rebirth(player)
	if not ok then
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end)

Remotes.get("UpgradeRequest").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, key)
	local ok, message = Economy.buyUpgrade(player, key)
	if not ok then
		Remotes.send(player, "Notify", message)
	end
end)

-- The client asks for a fresh snapshot when it boots.
Remotes.get("GetState").OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return Economy.hudState(player)
end

-- Brainrot Bay: the beach bases.
-- Eight bases ring the plaza. A player claims one on join; their
-- brainrots stand on its plots and earn money. The owner can lock
-- the base, which stops every steal until the lock runs out.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local State = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("State"))
local Remotes = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Remotes"))

local Bases = {}
Bases.world = nil
Bases.taken = {}

-- Claim the first free base for a player. Returns its index.
function Bases.claimBase(player)
	for index = 1, Config.BASE_COUNT do
		if not Bases.taken[index] then
			Bases.taken[index] = player
			local base = Bases.world.bases[index]
			if base then
				base.signLabel.Text = player.DisplayName .. "'s BASE"
			end
			return index
		end
	end
	return 0
end

function Bases.releaseBase(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return
	end
	local index = record.baseIndex
	if index > 0 and Bases.taken[index] == player then
		Bases.taken[index] = nil
		local base = Bases.world.bases[index]
		if base then
			base.signLabel.Text = "EMPTY BASE"
			base.lockGui.Enabled = false
		end
	end
end

function Bases.baseOf(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record or record.baseIndex < 1 then
		return nil
	end
	return Bases.world.bases[record.baseIndex]
end

function Bases.ownerOf(index)
	return Bases.taken[index]
end

-- Is this player standing on their own base's platform?
function Bases.onOwnBase(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record or record.baseIndex < 1 then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return false
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	local base = Bases.world.bases[record.baseIndex]
	local offset = root.Position - base.center
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= 20 and math.abs(offset.Z) <= 20
end

-- Is a position inside ANY base's platform? The tsunami spares those.
function Bases.insideAnyBase(position)
	for _, base in ipairs(Bases.world.bases) do
		local offset = position - base.center
		if math.abs(offset.X) <= 20 and math.abs(offset.Z) <= 20 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Place a brainrot model on a player's free plot. Returns the plot
-- index, or nil when the base is full.
function Bases.placeOnPlot(player, model, def, mutation)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return nil
	end
	local plotIndex = State.freePlot(player)
	if not plotIndex then
		return nil
	end
	local base = Bases.world.bases[record.baseIndex]
	if not base then
		return nil
	end
	local plotPosition = base.plots[plotIndex]
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(plotPosition + Vector3.new(0, def.size.Y / 2 + 1, 0)))
	model.Parent = base.folder
	record.plots[plotIndex] = {
		def = def,
		mutation = mutation,
		model = model,
		rate = def.rate * mutation.mult,
	}
	table.insert(record.owned, record.plots[plotIndex])
	-- A rival's touch steals it: watch the body from now on.
	-- Required lazily here, since Steal requires Bases too.
	require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Steal")).watchPlot(player, plotIndex, record.plots[plotIndex])
	return plotIndex
end

-- Lift a brainrot off its owner's plot, for stealing or rebirth.
function Bases.liftFromPlot(owner, plotIndex)
	local record = State.get(owner)
	if not record then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = record.plots[plotIndex]
	if not entry then
		return nil
	end
	record.plots[plotIndex] = nil
	for index, owned in ipairs(record.owned) do
		if owned == entry then
			table.remove(record.owned, index)
			break
		end
	end
	return entry
end

-- Lock the caller's base. Steals stop until the lock runs out.
function Bases.lockBase(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return false, "no record"
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < record.lockReadyAt then
		return false, "lock is cooling down"
	end
	record.lockUntil = now + Config.LOCK_TIME
	record.lockReadyAt = now + Config.LOCK_TIME + Config.LOCK_COOLDOWN
	local base = Bases.world.bases[record.baseIndex]
	if base then
		base.lockGui.Enabled = true
		task.delay(Config.LOCK_TIME, function()
			if base.lockGui then
				base.lockGui.Enabled = false
			end
		end)
	end
	Remotes.broadcast("BaseLocked", player.DisplayName, Config.LOCK_TIME)
	return true, "locked"
end

function Bases.isLocked(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return false
	end
	return os.clock() < record.lockUntil
end

function Bases.lockRemaining(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, record.lockUntil - os.clock())
end

return Bases

-- Brainrot Bay: the brainrot models.
-- Every brainrot is built from plain parts in code: a body in its
-- shape and colour, eyes, an accessory, and a billboard label with
-- its name, its rarity and its money per second. No catalog assets,
-- so the place runs anywhere and the screenshots carry the look.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local Format = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Format"))

local BrainrotModels = {}

-- A small helper for one part of a brainrot.
local function modelPart(model, name, size, offset, color, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if shape == "Ball" then
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	elseif shape == "Cylinder" then
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	else
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(offset)
	end
	part.Parent = model
	return part
end

-- Eyes: two white balls with black pupils, on the body's front face.
local function addEyes(model, def, front)
	local y = def.size.Y * 0.18

-- Brainrots wash ashore at the dock, stroll east along the beach,
-- and walk into the sea if nobody buys them. Each spawn rolls its
-- rarity from the ladder and its mutation from the table; during
-- Golden Hour the mutation chances triple.

Spawner.wild = {}
Spawner.goldenHour = false
Spawner.running = false

-- One wild brainrot: its definition, its mutation, its model, where
-- it is on the walk and how fast it strolls.
function Spawner.spawnOne(parent)
	local def = Config.rollBrainrot()
	local mutation = Config.rollMutation(Spawner.goldenHour)
	local start = Config.CONVEYOR_START
	local model = BrainrotModels.buildBrainrot(def, mutation, start, math.rad(90))
	model.Parent = parent
	local entry = {
		def = def,
		mutation = mutation,
		model = model,
		distance = 0,
		speed = def.walk,
		bornAt = os.clock(),
	}
	table.insert(Spawner.wild, entry)
	return entry
end

-- Move every wild brainrot one step east. A brainrot that reaches
-- the sea, or outlives its lifetime, is swept away.
function Spawner.stepWild(dt)
	local length = Config.CONVEYOR_END.X - Config.CONVEYOR_START.X
	for index = #Spawner.wild, 1, -1 do
		local entry = Spawner.wild[index]
		if not entry.model.Parent then
			table.remove(Spawner.wild, index)
		else
			entry.distance = entry.distance + entry.speed * dt
			local x = Config.CONVEYOR_START.X + entry.distance
			local bob = math.sin(os.clock() * 6 + index) * 0.15
			entry.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, Config.CONVEYOR_START.Y + bob, Config.CONVEYOR_START.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
			if entry.distance >= length or os.clock() - entry.bornAt > Config.CONVEYOR_LIFETIME then
				Spawner.removeWild(entry)
				table.remove(Spawner.wild, index)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Spawner.removeWild(entry)
	if entry.model then
		entry.model:Destroy()
	end
end

function Spawner.removeEntry(entry)
	for index, other in ipairs(Spawner.wild) do
		if other == entry then
			table.remove(Spawner.wild, index)
			break
		end
	end
	Spawner.removeWild(entry)
end

-- The closest wild brainrot to a point, within a range.
function Spawner.nearestWild(position, range)
	local best = nil
	local bestDistance = range
	for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.wild) do
		if entry.model.Parent and entry.model.PrimaryPart then
			local distance = (entry.model.PrimaryPart.Position - position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestDistance then
				best = entry
				bestDistance = distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestDistance
end

function Spawner.rainBurst(parent, count)
	for _ = 1, count do
		local def = Config.rollBrainrot()
		while def.rarity == "Common" do
			def = Config.rollBrainrot()
		end
		local mutation = Config.rollMutation(Spawner.goldenHour)
		local x = Config.CONVEYOR_START.X + math.random() * 200
		local model = BrainrotModels.buildBrainrot(def, mutation, Vector3.new(x, Config.CONVEYOR_START.Y, Config.CONVEYOR_START.Z), math.rad(90))
		model.Parent = parent
		table.insert(Spawner.wild, {
			def = def,
			mutation = mutation,
			model = model,
			distance = x - Config.CONVEYOR_START.X,
			speed = def.walk,
			bornAt = os.clock(),
		})
	end
end

-- The spawn loop: one new brainrot every few seconds, forever.

	if Spawner.running then
		return
	end
	Spawner.running = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.SPAWN_INTERVAL)
			Spawner.spawnOne(parent)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local last = os.clock()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local now = os.clock()
			Spawner.stepWild(now - last)
			last = now
		end
	end)

State.players = {}

-- A fresh record for a player who just joined.
function State.newPlayerRecord(player)
	return {
		player = player,
		cash = Config.START_CASH,
		totalEarned = 0,
		rebirths = 0,
		mult = 1,
		owned = {},
		plots = {},
		plotCount = Config.PLOTS_PER_BASE,
		baseIndex = 0,
		carrying = nil,
		slapReadyAt = 0,
		catchReadyAt = 0,
		lockUntil = 0,
		lockReadyAt = 0,
		upgrades = { Speed = 0, Range = 0, Plots = 0, Boost = 0 },
		eventMult = 1,
	}
end

function State.addPlayer(player, baseIndex)
	local record = State.newPlayerRecord(player)
	record.baseIndex = baseIndex
	State.players[player.UserId] = record
	return record
end

function State.get(player)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" then
		return State.players[player.UserId]
	end
	return State.players[player]
end

function State.removePlayer(player)
	State.players[player.UserId] = nil
end

-- Money in, money out. Returns false when the player cannot afford it.
function State.spend(player, amount)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record or record.cash < amount then
		return false
	end
	record.cash = record.cash - amount
	return true
end

function State.earn(player, amount)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return
	end
	record.cash = record.cash + amount
	record.totalEarned = record.totalEarned + amount
end

-- The player's current $/s from owned brainrots, before multipliers.
function State.baseRate(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return 0
	end
	local total = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(record.owned) do
		total = total + entry.rate
	end
	return total
end

-- The full multiplier: rebirths, Boost upgrades and the live event.
function State.multiplier(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return 1
	end
	local mult = record.mult
	mult = mult * (1.5 ^ record.upgrades.Boost)
	mult = mult * record.eventMult
	return mult
end

-- The $/s the HUD shows: base rate times every multiplier.
function State.effectiveRate(player)
	return State.baseRate(player) * State.multiplier(player)
end

function State.walkSpeed(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return 16
	end
	local speed = 16 * (1 + 0.15 * record.upgrades.Speed)
	if record.carrying then
		speed = speed * Config.CARRY_SLOW
	end
	return speed
end

function State.catchRange(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return Config.CATCH_RANGE_BASE
	end
	return Config.CATCH_RANGE_BASE + 4 * record.upgrades.Range
end

function State.freePlot(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return nil
	end
	for index = 1, record.plotCount do
		if not record.plots[index] then
			return index
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function State.plotCount(player)
	local record = State.get(player)
	if not record then
		return 0
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, _ in pairs(record.plots) do
		count = count + 1
	end

end

function State.allPlayers()
	local list = {}
	for _, record in pairs(State.players) do
		table.insert(list, record.player)
	end
	return list
end

function State.allRecords()
	local list = {}
	for _, record in pairs(State.players) do
		table.insert(list, record)
	end
	return list

-- Brainrot Bay: the tsunami.
-- Every two minutes the sea rises. Ten seconds of siren warning,
-- then a wall of water sweeps the island from north to south.
-- Bases are safe ground; anyone caught outside is washed back to
-- spawn and drops whatever they carry. Wild brainrots are swept
-- away with the wave.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local State = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("State"))
local Remotes = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Remotes"))
local Bases = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Bases"))
local Steal = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Steal"))
local Spawner = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Spawner"))

local Tsunami = {}
Tsunami.nextAt = 0
Tsunami.wave = nil
Tsunami.running = false

-- Build the wave wall once: a huge translucent slab, parked under
-- the island until the siren sounds.
function Tsunami.buildWave(folder)
	local wave = Instance.new("Part")
	wave.Name = "TsunamiWave"
	wave.Size = Vector3.new(520, 44, 12)
	wave.Position = Vector3.new(0, -60, -260)
	wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 220)
	wave.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	wave.Transparency = 0.3
	wave.Anchored = true
	wave.CanCollide = false
	wave.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	wave.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	wave.Parent = folder
	Tsunami.wave = wave
	return wave
end

-- Wash one player out: drop what they carry, send them to spawn.
function Tsunami.washOut(player)
	Steal.dropCarried(player, "washed away by the tsunami")
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Config.SPAWN_POINT)
	end
	Remotes.send(player, "Notify", "The tsunami washed you back to spawn!")
end

-- Sweep the wave across the island. Anyone outside a base is washed.
function Tsunami.sweep()
	local wave = Tsunami.wave
	if not wave then
		return
	end
	Remotes.broadcast("TsunamiStart")
	local steps = 40
	for step = 1, steps do
		local z = -260 + (520 * step / steps)
		wave.Position = Vector3.new(0, 20, z)
		for _, player in ipairs(State.allPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root and math.abs(root.Position.Z - z) < 10 and not Bases.insideAnyBase(root.Position) then
					Tsunami.washOut(player)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(Config.TSUNAMI_WAVE_TIME / steps)
	end
	wave.Position = Vector3.new(0, -60, -260)
	for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.wild) do
		Spawner.removeWild(entry)
	end
	Spawner.wild = {}
	Remotes.broadcast("TsunamiEnd")
end

-- One full cycle: warn, then sweep, then schedule the next.
function Tsunami.cycle()
	Remotes.broadcast("TsunamiWarning", Config.TSUNAMI_WARNING)
	task.wait(Config.TSUNAMI_WARNING)
	Tsunami.sweep()
	Tsunami.nextAt = os.clock() + Config.TSUNAMI_PERIOD
end

function Tsunami.start(folder)
	if Tsunami.running then
		return
	end
	Tsunami.running = true
	Tsunami.buildWave(folder)
	Tsunami.nextAt = os.clock() + Config.TSUNAMI_PERIOD
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local waitFor = Tsunami.nextAt - os.clock()
			if waitFor > 0 then
				task.wait(waitFor)
			end
			Tsunami.cycle()
		end
	end)
end

function Tsunami.secondsUntil()
	return math.max(0, Tsunami.nextAt - os.clock())
end

return Tsunami
